quests.name: Win a Game
quests.desc: Win a single match in any mode.
quests.how: Finish any completed game — ranked, custom, solo, or tournament — with the win.

quests.name: Win 3 Games
quests.how: Wins count across every mode and don't need to be consecutive. Progress carries through the day.

quests.name: Win 10 Games
quests.how: A full-session grind: every completed win in any mode adds one, until you hit ten.

quests.name: Win a Perfect Game (7–0)
quests.desc: Take all seven categories in one match.
quests.how: Win the game 7–0. Losing or tying even one category breaks the perfect run.

quests.name: Lose a Game 0–7
quests.desc: Lose every category in one match.
quests.how: Finish a game 0–7 — a consolation reward for a total wipeout. The result still counts as a loss.

quests.name: Win a Money Game
quests.desc: Win a match picking only money categories.
quests.how: As the picker, choose at least 2 categories and make EVERY one of your picks a money stat, then win the game. Categories your opponent picks don't count.

quests.name: Win a Time Game
quests.desc: Win a match picking only time categories.
quests.how: As the picker, choose at least 2 categories and make EVERY one of your picks a time stat, then win the game. Categories your opponent picks don't count.
